scripts.test:wpt-typed-om:chrome: pnpm run build && (python3 submodules/web-platform-tests/wpt run --processes 16 --headless -y --log-wptreport dist/report-chrome.json --log-wptscreenshot dist/chrome-screenshots.txt --log-html dist/report-chrome.html --inject-script dist/cssomnom.iife.global.js chrome css/css-typed-om || true) && node scripts/generate_wpt_report.ts
scripts.test:wpt-typed-om:firefox: pnpm run build && (python3 submodules/web-platform-tests/wpt run --processes 16 --headless -y --log-wptreport dist/report-firefox.json --log-wptscreenshot dist/firefox-screenshots.txt --log-html dist/report-firefox.html --inject-script dist/cssomnom.iife.global.js firefox css/css-typed-om || true) && node scripts/generate_wpt_report.ts
scripts.preflight: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test:node
scripts.submodules:upgrade: git submodule update --init --remote && pnpm run submodules:update
scripts.maintain: pnpm update --latest && pnpm run submodules:upgrade && pnpm run codegen && pnpm run external:extract && pnpm run preflight
